ops.text: Start a tccd/containermanagerd log stream in a second terminal to catch any live consent prompt during the upgrade, then leave it running through the brew upgrade.
ops.command: log stream --predicate 'process == "tccd" OR process == "containermanagerd" OR subsystem == "com.apple.TCC"' --info 2>&1 | tee ~/tcc-upgrade-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log
